notes: New: Swipe up on the mini player (Radio/TV and Music) to open the full Now Playing screen, not just tap. Podcasts' language filter now lets you pick more than one language at once, matching Radio and TV. Improved: The equalizer's custom bands now show the actual dB value next to each slider, plus a Reset button. Pulling down to refresh on Radio/TV now confirms the list is already up to date instead of doing nothing - it keeps itself current in the background. The notification permission is now asked the first time something actually plays, not immediately on opening the app. The combined language/state filter chip is easier to read at a glance. The equalizer's Bass band now points to the separate Bass enhancement setting, and a preset picked while Auto EQ is on is now marked so it's clear it hasn't taken effect yet. Fixed: The hardware/gesture back button while in Sound effects no longer closes all of Settings - it just returns to the Settings list. The welcome screen and the "update available" prompt could occasionally show stacked on top of each other on first launch.
